principle: Only meaningful, public-safe engineering work is published. Raw commits, private conversations, credentials, proprietary logic and unverified claims stay out of the public feed.

active.title: Public worklog and activity publishing
active.summary: Turning ongoing Aixion engineering work into a curated public activity layer that can surface current work, evidence and next gates without exposing raw repository or conversation data.
active.evidence: Pulse is moving from hard-coded ship-log entries to a structured manifest shared with the public site.
active.next_gate: Pass production CI, publish the first activity feed and use it for future meaningful milestones.

entries.title: Production candidate passed release gates
entries.summary: The launch candidate passed static-export, browser, accessibility, internal-link, reduced-motion and production-content checks before promotion.
entries.evidence: 92 browser tests passed with 8 intentional project-specific skips on the validated candidate.
entries.next_gate: Complete custom-domain DNS and HTTPS propagation and monitor the production site.

entries.title: Aixion Signal became the interaction language
entries.summary: The site now uses state-driven motion, interactive system-field paths, architecture-specific reveal patterns and reduced-motion fallbacks instead of generic decorative animation.
entries.evidence: Award-motion acceptance tests and desktop/mobile renders passed in the production suite.
entries.next_gate: Judge the live-browser feel and keep future motion changes evidence-led.

entries.title: Website architecture and visual authority frozen
entries.summary: The rebuild was anchored to a single public architecture, state vocabulary and light-mineral visual system before implementation continued.
entries.evidence: The master blueprint and visual authority became the implementation boundary for the clean rebuild.
entries.next_gate: Translate the authority into production components without reintroducing superseded visual directions.

entries.title: Research and live evidence kept separate from proprietary strategy detail
entries.summary: The public TradeBot story exposes architecture, validation method and evidence boundaries without publishing private signal mechanics or execution rules.
entries.evidence: Public pages distinguish research evidence, live observation, risk and human authority instead of collapsing them into one claim.
entries.next_gate: Add sanitized operational proof only when it is safe and evidence-backed.

entries.title: MVP orchestration translated into inspectable stages
entries.summary: Intent, context, planning, agents, tools, evidence, policy and authority were separated into explicit stages for the public architecture.
entries.evidence: The site presents a labelled demo trace while explicitly avoiding fake production telemetry.
entries.next_gate: Promote a policy-bound execution trace backed by implementation evidence.
